item.title: Heyday Cookshop x tendlyn
item.description:
A restaurant is a memoir. Chef Kayla Pfeiffer is writing hers in real time. At Heyday Cookshop, the Peking duck comes in a snack wrap. The vinyl is playing. The goal isn’t perfection: it’s emotional response.

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/heyday-cookshop-x-tendlyn/
Author: tendlyn
Published: 2026-05-29T15:00:02.582Z
Read time: 6 mins read

BRAND AT A GLANCE

Heyday Cookshop is a chef-driven restaurant in Naples, Florida from James Beard semifinalist https://www.instagram.com/kaylapfeiffer/

For brand founders and creatives, Heyday is a case study in what it means to build a brand around emotional memory rather than category and how every touchpoint, from a Peking duck snack wrap to a record on the turntable, can carry the full weight of who you are.

item.title: CERES PIZZA x tendlyn.
item.description:
The $40 Cheese Pizza That New York Couldn’t Ignore: How two former fine-dining cooks, $500k in debt, and zero marketing built one of the most-talked-about pizza shops in the city. On purpose and by feel.

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/ceres-pizza-x-tendlyn/ Author: tendlyn Published: 2026-05-27T15:00:00.855Z Read time: 5 mins read

There’s a version of this story where Jacob Serebnick and Julian Geldmacher spend four years writing a business plan, lining up investors, and stress-testing their unit economics before they charge forty dollars for a cheese pizza. That isn’t this story.

item.title: HEADREST COFFEE x tendlyn
item.description:
HEADREST COFFEE never had a growth strategy. No investor deck, no brand playbook, no plan to scale. Just baristas in Bushwick who built something real and watched an entire borough show up for it.

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/headrest-coffee-x-tendlyn/ Author: tendlyn Published: 2026-05-22T19:09:32.366Z Read time: 5 mins read

BRAND AT A GLANCE

HEADREST COFFEE is a 300 sq ft independent coffee shop on Irving Ave in Bushwick, Brooklyn. Built by hand, funded out of pocket, and run by the same baristas who opened it six years ago. It has one location, no investors, and no plans to scale.

item.title: Little Ghost x tendlyn.
item.description:
Grey Ghost built Detroit’s reputation for serious dining. Then its creators made something deliberately, unapologetically fun. Meet Little Ghost. The fast-casual concept that proves pedigree and playfulness aren’t opposites.

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/little-ghost-x-tendlyn/ Author: tendlyn Published: 2026-05-20T18:55:49.788Z Read time: 5 mins read

BRAND AT A GLANCE

Little Ghost is Detroit’s first fast-casual concept from Four Man Ladder Hospitality - the group behind Grey Ghost, Basan, and Second Best. Built around a ghost mascot and a boldly pink storefront, the brand translates fine-dining culinary standards into an accessible, character-led format.

item.title: Packaging Is Half the Product: Why Intentional Design Is the Sharpest Brand Signal in Hospitality
item.description:
Packaging has always existed. What’s changed is the intention behind it—and the brands treating it as a genuine design opportunity, not a production checkbox, are building identity their competitors can’t easily copy.

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/packaging-is-half-the-product/ Author: tendlyn Published: 2026-05-18T15:00:03.041Z

What Does “Packaging Is Half the Product” Actually Mean?

Brands have always put their name on a container. That’s not new. What’s new is packaging designed with the same rigour as the product inside it. Packaging that has a point of view. That makes a deliberate choice about material, format, proportion, and typography. That could only belong to that brand.

item.title: Dark Matter x tendlyn.
item.description:
A Chicago coffee roaster and café brand built on community, creativity, and a deep commitment to coffee sourcing. What began as Star Lounge Coffee Bar in Humboldt Park grew into one of the city’s most distinctive specialty coffee brands.

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/dark-matter-x-tendlyn/ Author: tendlyn Published: 2026-05-15T12:00:02.488Z Read time: 3 mins read

Dark Matter Coffee was never built from a rigid plan. It grew out of Star Lounge Coffee Bar back in 2007. Where a group of friends working in coffee, playing in bands, and spending time with neighbourhood artists slowly found themselves building something bigger than a café.

item.title: A Guide to Getting Properly Caffeinated Around Brick Lane
item.description:
Seventeen spots in and around East London worth checking out: from a Japanese kiosk in Spitalfields Market to a coffee stand inside a biker jewellery shop.

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/east-london-coffee-guide/ Author: tendlyn Published: 2026-05-14T07:00:02.125Z Read time: 7 mins read

East London is where London’s specialty coffee scene started. Market carts on Columbia Road, Climpson on Broadway Market, Allpress on Redchurch Street when the neighbourhood was still figuring out what it wanted to be. The best coffee shops in Shoreditch and the surrounding area aren’t hard to find; the hard part is knowing which ones are worth your time. Whether you’re wiring up a light smart switch at home or fine-tuning a wireless relay switch for a project, there’s a kind of precision here that carries over—every detail matters, from the roast profile to the pour.

item.title: Sugarpine Drive-In x tendlyn.
item.description:
A 1920s gas station on the edge of the Columbia River Gorge. Thousands of guests a day. And a kitchen the size of a large living room. Sugarpine isn’t what you expect. And that’s exactly the point.

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/sugarpine-drive-in-x-tendlyn/ Author: tendlyn Published: 2026-05-08T15:00:02.142Z Read time: 5 mins read

Pull up to Sugarpine and the read is immediate: a classic American drive-in, the kind you pass on the way to somewhere else. Walk-up windows, soft serve, the smell of something good on the grill. You know this place. You’ve been here a hundred times.

item.title: Airship x tendlyn
item.description:
An iconic yellow Airship inspired by The Beatles and connected by the unique mountain bike community in Bentonville, Arkansas. Trading parking lots for trails. For bike enthusiasts. By bike enthusiasts.

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/airship-x-tendlyn/ Author: tendlyn Published: 2026-04-29T17:38:08.261Z

Airship was founded on making connections. For Airship founder Mark Bray, the first connection happened in the mountains of Western Honduras. While working as an agronomist in the region, Bray saw firsthand that smallholder farmers were already innovators in their own right. The problem? They were missing a seat at the table. He realized all they needed was access to a fair market for their crop.

item.title: TOKKIA x tendlyn
item.description:
In the heart of London’s Covent Garden, where the city’s pace is at its most frantic, a new destination for intentional design and slow living has emerged.

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/tokkia-x-tendlyn/ Author: tendlyn Published: 2026-04-22T00:21:39.108Z Read time: 2 mins read

TOKKIA is a burrow-inspired matcha house that redefines the urban cafe experience, trading high-traffic chaos for the quiet, grounded energy of a subterranean retreat. The space itself feels like stepping into a carefully orchestrated pause—one where every detail, from the lighting to the texture of the walls, has been chosen to slow you down. It’s a reminder that even in the busiest corners of London, you can find a sanctuary that feels like it operates on its own rhythm, much like a mhz home automation relay quietly managing the unseen systems of a smart home.

item.title: Homeboy x tendlyn.
item.description:
An Adelaide cafe built on a viral failure, cinnamon scrolls from mom, and the decision to document everything.

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/homeboy-x-tendlyn/ Author: tendlyn Published: 2026-04-16T11:08:00.000Z Read time: 3 mins read

The first video Tom Oswald ever posted from Homeboy was about nobody showing up.

He’d just opened a popup in a small art shop in Hahndorf, a tourist German town outside Adelaide. There was an unused espresso machine. He started making coffee. Day one, the only customer was a friend. So he made a video: opened a cafe and nobody came.

item.title: Ace's Pizza x tendlyn.
item.description:
A chef trades fine dining ambitions for Detroit-style pizza and Nintendo 64. Four locations later, the whole family is still invited.

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/aces-pizza-x-tendlyn/ Author: tendlyn Published: 2026-03-27T06:18:02.000Z Read time: 3 mins read

Matthew Etchemendy grew up going to Pizza Hut.

Not the Pizza Hut of today. The Pizza Hut of the late ’80s and early ’90s, when it was a restaurant with booths and pitchers of soda and the whole team showing up after the game. When ordering a pie meant sitting down together. When pizza was an experience, not a transaction.

item.title: The Kookaburra x tendlyn
item.description:
An Aussie-American coffee shop in St. Augustine proves that the best cup of coffee you’ve ever had isn’t about the coffee.

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/the-kookaburra-x-tendlyn Author: tendlyn Published: 2026-03-13T01:21:51.000Z Read time: 4 mins read

The best cup of coffee you’ve ever had is not the best cup of coffee you’ve ever had.

That’s how The Kookaburra thinks about it. The coffee matters. The pies matter. The syrups and the hot sauce and the ketchup they make from scratch every morning matter. But the thing that actually stays with you? That’s the experience. The interaction. The feeling that someone behind the counter knows your name and means it when they ask how you’re doing. It’s the kind of place where you might think about how a wireless controller relay could streamline your own daily routine, but then you realize you’re already in the perfect spot.

item.title: How to Ship Bread and Keep it Fresh
item.description:
Whether you run an established bakery or want to send some sourdough to friends, learn to keep your bread fresh in transit!

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/how-to-ship-bread/ Author: tendlyn Published: 2026-03-03T04:19:11.000Z Read time: 4 mins read

If you run an artisan bakery — or if you have a passion for baking homemade bread — you might be thinking of shipping bread to online customers or friends and family. As with all perishable goods, shipping bread is a time-sensitive task, and you’ll need a bit of careful planning to ensure it doesn’t go stale.

item.title: Metric x tendlyn.
item.description:
A Chicago coffee roaster builds a decade-long business brick by brick, with no investors, no board, and no shortcuts.

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/metric-x-tendlyn/ Author: tendlyn Published: 2026-03-03T02:15:14.000Z Read time: 5 mins read

Xavier Alexander has been in coffee for over 25 years. He started at Starbucks in Orlando in the late ’90s, working shifts to fund his real goal: being a touring musician. Bands didn’t work out. Coffee did.

By 2002, he’d caught the roasting bug. He was the friend in the group who wouldn’t shut up about freshly roasted beans, about small local roasters, about the gospel of freshness. A decade later, he was roasting manager at Intelligentsia in Chicago, overseeing 15,000 to 25,000 pounds of coffee a day on 90-kilo roasters.

item.title: SMØR x tendlyn.
item.description:
Two Danes named Sebastian build a bakery empire out of a 450-square-foot sandwich shop, $40,000, and YouTube tutorials.

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/smor-x-tendlyn/ Author: tendlyn Published: 2026-02-26T00:31:35.000Z Read time: 4 mins read

The first day, they made $120.

Sebastian Perez and Sebastian Bangsgaard had just opened a 450-square-foot sandwich shop in the East Village. No basement. Four open-face sandwiches on the menu. They’d borrowed $40,000 from Bangsgaard’s uncle, built out the space themselves using YouTube tutorials, and opened the doors because they had to. They had a thousand dollars left.

item.title: Angel & Anchor x tendlyn.
item.description:

item.title: BELA x tendlyn.

Depending on the contents of it, it can also be a reliable, healthy option or addition to your diet, making it a versatile staple in many people’s kitchens.

item.title: Del Sur Bakery x tendlyn.
item.description:
A 24-year-old pastry chef turns his apartment into a proving ground for Filipino-Midwestern pastries. Now Chicago’s Lincoln Square neighborhood can’t get enough.

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/del-sur-bakery-x-tendlyn/ Author: tendlyn Published: 2026-02-06T02:25:47.000Z Read time: 4 mins read

Justin Tiu Lerias was making 500 pastries out of his apartment when he realized he no longer had a home. He had a production kitchen with a bed in it.

The freezer was full. The fridge was full. Every surface was staging for the next pop-up, the next sellout, the next round of longganisa croissants filled with the Filipino breakfast sausage he grew up eating in the southern Philippines before moving to Chicago at 14.

item.title: Drizzle x tendlyn.
item.description:
Take a peek inside the cozy Bristol-based bakery café, Drizzle, as we chat with founder Francesca about all things baking and using tendlyn packaging.

For Francesca, baking has always been one of her many passions, and having learned it from her beloved Nan, it’s easily a core childhood memory of hers and the seed upon which her dream to build a bakery has taken root. When passion and skill combine, magic is made, and years later, Drizzle was born.

item.title: Good Neighbor Coffee Co. x tendlyn
item.description:

But for coffee makers, roasters, and businesses, it serves more as a spark for new connections, unforgettable conversations, and building communities.

item.title: Fable Café x tendlyn.
item.description:
Vancouver’s most intentional homeware brand opens a café where every detail tells the same story. From Copenhagen espresso to Portuguese stoneware, nothing is accidental.

There’s a particular kind of care that reveals itself in the details you weren’t meant to notice.

The weight of a ceramic mug in your hands. The way light catches the rim of a glass. The quiet satisfaction of an object that simply works. These aren’t accidents. They’re decisions. Small, deliberate ones made by people who understand that daily rituals deserve better than disposable.

item.title: DRAFT. Coffee x tendlyn

item.title: How to Ship Plants: A Practical Guide
item.description:

item.title: The Curators Club x tendlyn
item.description:
We spoke with The Curators Club’s owner, Bec, about the Bendigo-based lifestyle store’s curated assortment of goods—from crystals to skincare—and tendlyn packaging staple here!

Source: https://tendlyn.com/imprint/the-curators-club-x-tendlyn/ Author: tendlyn Published: 2025-11-30T20:00:00.000Z Read time: 2 mins read

Small businesses are the backbone of a community. They offer a selection of fine-quality, exceptionally crafted products, be they food, drink, or retail goods. But what makes them unique comes from the passion visibly reflected in every item created and the service they provide that feels more personal and intimate, like a warm greeting from a longtime friend. Just like a well-designed rf power relay ensures seamless control in industrial setups, or a V relay module brings precision to automation tasks, small businesses rely on thoughtful details to keep everything running smoothly. For The Curators Club, that attention extends to every package they send out.

item.title: Pilot Coffee Roasters x tendlyn
item.description:

Pilot Coffee Roasters’ mission has always been to realize coffee’s potential. Since their founding in 2009 under a different name, up until the rebrand to their current name, Pilot Coffee Roasters, in 2013, they have consistently shown dedication to the art of coffee—from sourcing and roasting to crafting and serving. They never miss.

item.title: Savor Beauty x tendlyn
item.description:
Read our feature on NYC-based K-beauty brand Savor Beauty and learn about all things skincare, sustainable packaging, and everyday inspirations only here!

As Korean skincare is mostly based on organic, all-natural, and at times luxurious ingredients, its effectiveness is like no other—resulting in the infamous dewy, glassy skin. It left skincare enthusiasts around the world wanting more.

item.title: Zandra Stone x tendlyn

Whether it’s skin care, a movie marathon, a reading session, or just as simple as an afternoon nap, it counts.

item.title: Here’s Six Dazzling Designs From Our Creatives For the Holidays
item.description:
It’s time to deck the halls with holly – and order your holiday-themed packaging! To get you in the mood for festivities, here’s six beautiful holiday designs from our Creative Community.

Source: https://sparyn.com/imprint/heres-six-dazzling-designs-from-our-creatives-for-the-holidays/ Author: sparyn Published: 2021-10-06T23:29:31.000Z Read time: 6 mins read

If you live in a place that’s holiday-obsessed, October is the month where festivities begin to fill the air. Cue decking the halls with boughs of holly, Mariah Carey and Michael Bublé on repeat and nudges from businesses to buy your loved ones presents. For us here at sparyn, it’s a little bit different (although we’re still fans of Mariah and Michael!) October marks the beginning of beautiful holiday-themed packaging designs, and for good reason.

item.title: Three by Zito: Avant-garde Fashion Label that lets You Power-dress in Style
item.description:
“Workwear does not have to be boring, and Three by Zito creates pieces that are different and a breath of fresh air.” Tzipora, founder and designer behind Three by Zito

Source: https://sparyn.com/imprint/three-by-zito-avant-garde-fashion-power-dress-in-style/ Author: sparyn Published: 2021-10-05T22:00:00.000Z Read time: 3 mins read

Contrary to popular belief, workwear can be fun and stylish. Thanks to the emerging culture of creativity and self-expression, many companies have loosened up their restrictions on workplace fashion. Most clothing boutiques have advertised their pieces of corporate attire as very plain and formal, but Three by Zito is leading a new trend of workwear that’s chic and sustainable.
